title: Jefferies' Chris Wood On Return of FPIs, AI Spending Warning & Long
description:
Why have foreign investors been pulling money out of India? Is the worst of the selling over? Can the AI investment boom sustain itself? And where does Chris Wood see opportunities for investors today? In an exclusive interview to Moneycontrol's Managing Editor Nalin Mehta, Wood, who is the Global Head of Equity Strategy at Jefferies and author of the widely followed Greed & Fear newsletter, shares his outlook on Indian markets, global capital flows, artificial intelligence, the Indian rupee as well as gold.
Wood argues that India's recent FPI outflows were driven less by domestic concerns and more by the global AI frenzy, which pushed investors towards semiconductor-heavy markets such as South Korea and Taiwan. He explains what could trigger a return of foreign capital to India and why the AI capex cycle remains the single biggest factor to watch.
